description.value: Rossland Community Garden is a shared community growing space in Rossland, BC, nestled in the Kootenay mountain region. Community gardens of this type typically offer plots tended by local residents, with seasonal produce and flowers. For a touring cyclist passing through Rossland's scenic mountain terrain, it may serve as a quiet green stopping point in the town.
